title: Basketball Score Explorer
text: Welcome to the Basketball Score Explorer website. This site visualizes the distribution of home and away score combinations from your game data.

title: Basketball Score Explorer
text:
About
The score heatmap page shows which score pairs occurred during the season and how frequently they appeared.

title: Basketball Score Heatmap
text: Explore the distribution of home and away score combinations across the season. Hover over the tiles to inspect each score pair and see how many games produced that exact result.
